name: Right Track youth jobs (YJ1 and YJ2 summer internships)
org: City of Saint Paul Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Paid summer jobs and internships. YJ1 places teens in rec centers, pools, libraries, gardening and nonprofits. YJ2 is for ages 16 and up in business, health, trades and other career fields.
who_can_apply: Saint Paul residents who live in a cost-burdened household (for example, they receive SNAP or Section 8) or have a barrier to employment. YJ1: at least 14 by June 1 and no older than 19 by Aug 25. YJ2: at least 16 by June 1 and no older than 21.
pay_detail: YJ1: at least $13.50 per hour, about 15 hours a week. YJ2: at least $16.37 per hour, 15 to 40 hours a week (as stated on the program page).
deadline_text: Youth apply online February 1-28 for summer. The page does not print the year, so confirm the dates for 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online youth application in February (have your Social Security number, household income, a phone number and an emergency contact email ready; YJ2 needs a resume). Then attend pre-employment training in March, Career Exploration Day and interviews.
notes: Very competitive: about 2,000 applicants for about 500 YJ1 internships (FAQ). Contact (651) 266-6363 or RightTrack@ci.stpaul.mn.us. The overview text says ages 14 to 24 across all Right Track programs; the summer teen programs are 14 to 21. Unplaced teens can join an online professional development program.
